title: anthemis abrotanifolia subsp. panachaica
intro: Anthemis abrotanifolia subsp. panachaica, commonly known as a type of yarrow, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and treating digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and carminative agent, helping to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Anthemis abrotanifolia subsp. panachaica include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
